test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name: A–Z (ascending)
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with multiple products having distinct names
test_cases.expected_result: Products_Table is sorted ascending by Name (A to Z); first row shows lexicographically smallest product name visible on screen

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name: Z–A (descending)
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with multiple products having distinct names
test_cases.expected_result: Products_Table is sorted descending by Name (Z to A); first row shows lexicographically largest product name visible on screen

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price: Low–High
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with multiple products having distinct prices
test_cases.expected_result: Products_Table is sorted by Price ascending (lowest price at top); first row shows product with lowest price visible on screen

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price: High–Low
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with multiple products having distinct prices
test_cases.expected_result: Products_Table is sorted by Price descending (highest price at top); first row shows product with highest price visible on screen

test_cases.test_case: Sort selection persists while navigating away and back to page
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated
steps: 3. Click a product to go to Product Detail page
4. Use browser Back or Inventory nav to return to Product Inventory page
test_cases.expected_result: Sort_Dropdown still shows 'Name: A–Z' and Products_Table remains sorted A–Z (or sorting persisted per app spec), visible rows remain in sorted order

test_cases.test_case: Sort stability with identical names (tie-breaker by Price or stable order)
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains multiple products with identical Name values and varying prices
test_cases.expected_result: Products with identical Name appear grouped together; within group ordering is stable (e.g., deterministic by Price or original insertion order) and consistent across repeated sorts

test_cases.test_case: Open Product Detail by clicking product Name
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with at least one product
steps: 2. Click the product Name link in a row
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to Product Detail page for that product; Product Detail page visible with product-specific information

test_cases.test_case: Open Product Detail by clicking product Image
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with products that include an Image
steps: 2. Click the product Image in a row
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to Product Detail page for that product; Product Detail page visible with product-specific information

test_cases.test_case: Clicking non-interactive area does not navigate to Product Detail
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated
steps: 2. Click within the row but not on Name or Image (e.g., click Description or empty area)
test_cases.expected_result: No navigation occurs; user remains on Product Inventory page and no Product Detail page is opened

test_cases.test_case: Add single item to cart from Products_Table
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains a product with Add to cart button (in_cart == false)
Cart_Badge shows N (N may be 0)
steps: 2. Click 'Add to cart' button for the chosen product
test_cases.expected_result: 'Add to cart' button changes to 'Remove' for that product; in_cart state becomes true; Cart_Badge increments to N+1 and displays updated count

test_cases.test_case: Remove single item from cart from Products_Table
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains a product already in cart with Remove button (in_cart == true)
Cart_Badge shows M (M >= 1)
steps: 2. Click 'Remove' button for the chosen product
test_cases.expected_result: 'Remove' button changes to 'Add to cart' for that product; in_cart state becomes false; Cart_Badge decrements to M-1 and displays updated count

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to 'Add to cart' when item already in cart (duplicate add)
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains a product already in cart (button shows 'Remove')
steps: 2. Click the 'Add to cart' button area for a product that currently shows 'Remove' (attempt duplicate action)
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Add to cart' action available because button displays 'Remove'; clicking 'Remove' removes item (separate flow). System prevents adding duplicate entries; Cart_Badge count remains unchanged from current value unless Remove is explicitly clicked

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to 'Remove' when item not in cart
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains a product not in cart (button shows 'Add to cart')
steps: 2. Click the 'Remove' button area for a product that currently shows 'Add to cart' (attempt invalid remove)
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Remove' action present because button displays 'Add to cart'; clicking the 'Add to cart' button will add the item instead. System does not decrement Cart_Badge or remove item since it is not in cart

test_cases.test_case: Add multiple distinct items updates Cart_Badge correctly
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table populated with at least 5 items all not in cart
Cart_Badge shows 0
steps: 2. Click 'Add to cart' for 5 different products sequentially
test_cases.expected_result: Each clicked product's button changes to 'Remove' and in_cart becomes true; Cart_Badge increments by 1 for each add and finally displays 5

test_cases.test_case: Rapid toggle Add/Remove does not create duplicate entries and keeps Cart_Badge consistent
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains at least one product not in cart
Cart_Badge shows initial count P
steps: 2. Rapidly click 'Add to cart' then 'Remove' then 'Add to cart' on the same product within 2 seconds (repeat 3 cycles)
3. Observe Cart_Badge and product button state after each click
test_cases.expected_result: No duplicate entries created; button toggles between 'Add to cart' and 'Remove' appropriately; Cart_Badge increments/decrements by 1 per action and final Cart_Badge equals P+1 if final state is in_cart true or P if final state false; no negative or >expected counts occur

test_cases.test_case: Sort with zero, very large and negative prices present (price value edge cases)
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains products with prices: 0.00, 0.01, very large (e.g., 9999999.99), and (if system allows) negative price -5.00
steps: 3. Observe ordering; then select 'Price: High–Low' and observe ordering
test_cases.expected_result: Low–High places negative prices first (if allowed) then 0.00 then ascending to large values; High–Low reverses order; UI displays prices correctly and sorts numerically rather than lexicographically

test_cases.test_case: Sorting names with mixed case is case-insensitive or follows defined behavior
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains names: 'apple', 'Banana', 'Apricot', 'banana'
steps: 3. Observe the order of mixed-case names
test_cases.expected_result: Products_Table sorts names in a consistent, defined manner (case-insensitive expected): 'apple', 'Apricot', 'Banana', 'banana' or otherwise documented stable order; no unexpected interleaving occurs

test_cases.test_case: Clicking Name navigates to Product Detail for long product names (UI truncation / ellipsis)
preconditions: User logged in as standard user
Products_Table contains a product with a very long Name (exceeds visible width and is truncated with ellipsis)
steps: 2. Click the visible truncated product Name (clickable area)
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation occurs to Product Detail page for that product despite truncation; Product Detail page shows full product name

test_cases.test_case: Add to cart when not logged in is blocked (authorization precondition)
preconditions: User is logged out
Products_Table accessible (e.g., public view) or user attempts to access Inventory page
steps: 1. Navigate to Product Inventory page while logged out
2. Attempt to click 'Add to cart' for any product
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked: user is prompted to log in or an authentication modal appears; no change to Cart_Badge occurs and button state remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart when product is not in cart
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product A
Product A state == Not in Cart
steps: 1. Verify the action bar displays a button labeled 'Add to cart'.
test_cases.expected_result: Action bar updates to display a 'Remove' button (product state transitions to In Cart) and the Product Detail page remains visible

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart when product is in cart
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product B
Product B state == In Cart
steps: 1. Verify the action bar displays a button labeled 'Remove'.
test_cases.expected_result: Action bar updates to display an 'Add to cart' button (product state transitions to Not in Cart) and the Product Detail page remains visible

test_cases.test_case: Navigate back to Product Inventory via 'Back to products' link
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for any product
steps: 1. Click the 'Back to products' link/button in the Product Detail page.
test_cases.expected_result: Application navigates to the Product Inventory page and Product Detail is no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Open Shopping Cart via Cart Icon
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for any product
steps: 1. Click the Cart Icon link on Product Detail page.
test_cases.expected_result: Application navigates to the Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to 'Add to cart' when product is already in cart (button should not attempt duplicate add)
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product C
Product C state == In Cart
steps: 1. Verify the action bar displays a 'Remove' button (not 'Add to cart').
2. Attempt to click an 'Add to cart' button (if present due to UI bug) or attempt to trigger add via keyboard shortcut.
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Add to cart' action is performed; action bar remains showing 'Remove' and no duplicate add occurs

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to 'Remove' when product is not in cart
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product D
Product D state == Not in Cart
steps: 1. Verify the action bar displays 'Add to cart' (not 'Remove').
2. Attempt to click a 'Remove' button (if present due to UI bug).
test_cases.expected_result: No 'Remove' action is performed; action bar remains showing 'Add to cart' and no error or negative change occurs

test_cases.test_case: Add to cart fails due to network error and shows inline error
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product E
Product E state == Not in Cart
Simulate network failure / API returns error on add request
steps: 2. Wait for the add action response (simulate network error).
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message is displayed (e.g. 'Could not add to cart. Try again.') and the action bar remains showing 'Add to cart'

test_cases.test_case: Back to products link is broken or missing (UI error)
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for any product
Back to products link is missing or its href is invalid
test_cases.expected_result: Either no navigation occurs and an inline error or no-op is observed, or user remains on Product Detail page; missing link is visible in UI audit

test_cases.test_case: Cart icon link is broken or not clickable
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for any product
Cart Icon is present but not clickable due to UI/JS error
test_cases.expected_result: No navigation to Shopping Cart occurs and an inline error or no-op is observed; Cart Icon must be reported as non-functional

test_cases.test_case: Rapid repeated clicks on 'Add to cart' result in single add (debounce/guard)
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product F
Product F state == Not in Cart
steps: 1. Rapidly click the 'Add to cart' button multiple times (5-10 clicks) within 1-2 seconds.
2. Observe the action bar and any UI feedback.
test_cases.expected_result: Only one state transition occurs and the action bar settles to display 'Remove'; no duplicate UI transitions or duplicate items are created in a single product slot

test_cases.test_case: Product with extremely long name and description displays without breaking layout
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product G
Product G has name length >= 500 characters and description length >= 2000 characters
steps: 1. Open Product Detail page for Product G.
2. Inspect how product name and description render on various viewport widths.
test_cases.expected_result: Name and description either wrap or are ellipsized according to design; price and action bar remain visible and usable; page layout does not break

test_cases.test_case: Product missing image shows placeholder
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product H
Product H has no image available (image URL 404 or null)
steps: 1. Open Product Detail page for Product H.
test_cases.expected_result: A placeholder image or clear empty-state graphic is displayed in place of the product image and the rest of the details and action bar remain visible

test_cases.test_case: Product price edge cases: zero, negative, very large values display correctly
preconditions: User on Product Detail page for Product I (price = 0), Product J (price < 0), Product K (price very large e.g., 999999999.99)
steps: 1. Open Product Detail page for Product I and inspect displayed price.
2. Open Product Detail page for Product J and inspect displayed price and any validation/warning.
3. Open Product Detail page for Product K and inspect displayed price formatting.
test_cases.expected_result: Prices are rendered with consistent formatting (e.g., currency symbol, decimals). For zero price, display 'Free' or '$0.00' as per spec; negative prices should show a clear validation or prefix (e.g., '-$X' or an admin error indicator); very large values are formatted with separators and do not break layout

test_cases.test_case: Product state updated externally (added/removed from another tab) reflects on Product Detail when refocused/refresh
preconditions: User has Product Detail page for Product L open in Tab A
User can modify cart in Tab B
steps: 1. In Tab B, add Product L to cart (so state becomes In Cart).
2. Return to Tab A (Product Detail) and either focus the tab or refresh the page.
4. In Tab B, remove Product L from cart (state becomes Not in Cart).
5. Return to Tab A and refresh/focus and observe the action bar state.
test_cases.expected_result: After focus/refresh, Product Detail action bar correctly reflects external changes: when added externally it shows 'Remove'; when removed externally it shows 'Add to cart'

test_cases.test_case: Remove single item from cart (happy path)

Cart contains exactly 1 item visible in Cart_Items_Table
steps: 2. Locate the single item row in Cart_Items_Table
test_cases.expected_result: Item row is removed from the table and the shopping cart shows an empty state message (e.g., 'Your cart is empty') on the current screen; Checkout button is disabled or hidden

test_cases.test_case: Remove one item from multiple items (happy path)

Cart contains 3 distinct items visible in Cart_Items_Table

Simulate network failure or API error for remove-item endpoint
steps: 2. Click the Remove button for any item row

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click Remove (negative / idempotency)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Cart contains at least 1 item
steps: 2. Rapidly click the same row's Remove button twice in quick succession
test_cases.expected_result: Item is removed only once; no duplicate errors or UI corruption; second click is ignored or disabled and no additional rows are removed on the current screen

Cart contains exactly 1 item
steps: 2. Click Remove on the last item row
test_cases.expected_result: Item row removed and page shows explicit empty cart state (e.g., 'Your cart is empty'); Checkout button is disabled or not clickable on the current screen

test_cases.test_case: Remove item with very long description and special characters (edge)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Cart contains an item whose description is extremely long (e.g., >1000 chars) and includes special characters
test_cases.expected_result: Item row is removed and UI does not break or overflow; other rows remain visible; any truncated display remains visually intact on the current screen

Shopping Cart page is open
steps: 1. On Shopping Cart page, click the Continue Shopping link
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to Product Inventory and the Product Inventory page is visible (product list displayed) on the current screen

test_cases.test_case: Continue Shopping link broken / 404 (negative)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Shopping Cart page is open
Simulate Product Inventory endpoint returning 404 or navigation failure
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation does not succeed; visible error or fallback appears on the current screen (e.g., 404 page or error toast 'Unable to load Product Inventory')

Shopping Cart page is open
Continue Shopping link is focusable

test_cases.test_case: Begin checkout with items in cart (happy path)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Cart contains at least 1 item
test_cases.expected_result: Checkout process begins and the user is navigated to the first checkout screen (e.g., shipping/address entry) visible on the current screen

test_cases.test_case: Attempt checkout with empty cart (negative)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Cart is empty
steps: 2. Attempt to click the Checkout button
test_cases.expected_result: Checkout is blocked: either Checkout button is disabled/unresponsive, or a visible message appears on the current screen (e.g., 'Your cart is empty') and no checkout navigation occurs

test_cases.test_case: Begin checkout under slow network (edge)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Cart contains at least 1 item
Simulate high latency on checkout initiation endpoint
test_cases.expected_result: Loading indicator or spinner is visible while checkout initializes; once the request completes the checkout page loads on the current screen; no duplicate navigations occur

test_cases.test_case: Cart with very large number of items (performance edge)

Cart contains a large number of items (e.g., 1000 rows)
steps: 2. Scroll to an arbitrary middle row
test_cases.expected_result: Specified item row is removed and UI remains responsive; table continues to scroll correctly and other rows remain intact on the current screen; removal completes within an acceptable time threshold (e.g., <2s)

test_cases.test_case: Long description truncation and tooltip behavior when removing (edge)
preconditions: User logged in as Shopper
Cart contains an item with a product name longer than visible column width
steps: 2. Hover over truncated product description to reveal tooltip (if implemented)
test_cases.expected_result: Tooltip shows full description on hover (if supported); after clicking Remove, the item row is removed and tooltip no longer appears; table layout remains consistent on the current screen

test_cases.test_case: Actions when user session is expired (negative / security)
preconditions: User was previously logged in as Shopper but session is expired
Shopping Cart page is open (session expired while on page)
steps: 1. Click Remove on any item row
test_cases.expected_result: Any of these actions redirect the user to the Login page or show a visible authentication error on the current screen (e.g., 'Please sign in'); no item removals or checkout progress occurs until authentication is completed

Overview step is displayed
steps: 1. On the Overview step, verify order summary, totals, payment and shipping info are visible
test_cases.expected_result: Completes order and redirects to Order Confirmation page showing order number, 'Thank you' message and order summary

steps: 1. On the Overview step, click the 'Cancel' button
test_cases.expected_result: Exits checkout and navigates back to shopping context (e.g., Shopping Cart or Product listing); the user is no longer in checkout flow and Overview screen is closed

test_cases.test_case: Finish blocked when no payment method is available
preconditions: User logged in as Customer
Cart contains items
No payment method is set or payment method is invalid
Overview step is displayed
steps: 1. On Overview, confirm payment section shows 'No payment method' or similar
test_cases.expected_result: Order is not completed; UI remains on Overview and a visible validation/error message is shown (e.g., 'Payment method required' or 'Please select a payment method') and 'Finish' does not complete the order

test_cases.test_case: Finish blocked when shipping address missing
preconditions: User logged in as Customer
Cart contains items

Overview step is displayed
steps: 1. On Overview, confirm shipping section indicates missing address
test_cases.expected_result: Order is not completed; Overview remains visible and a clear validation/error message is shown (e.g., 'Shipping address required') preventing completion until address is added

test_cases.test_case: Finish prevented when displayed totals differ from server calculation
preconditions: User logged in as Customer
Overview displays item prices and totals
Server-side price or tax changed causing mismatch with displayed totals
test_cases.expected_result: System blocks completion and displays a visible warning or modal indicating prices changed and shows updated totals; user remains on Overview and must acknowledge or refresh to proceed

test_cases.test_case: Handle network/server error when finishing order
preconditions: User logged in as Customer
Cart valid, payment and shipping set
Overview step displayed
Simulate network error or server 5xx on submit
steps: 2. Simulate a network/server failure response from order submission endpoint
test_cases.expected_result: Order is not completed; Overview remains visible and a clear error notification is displayed (e.g., 'Unable to complete order. Please try again later.'); 'Finish' becomes available for retry or a retry control is shown

test_cases.test_case: Overview displays correct totals calculation (item total + tax = total)
preconditions: User logged in as Customer
Cart contains known items with deterministic prices (e.g., Item A $10 x2, Item B $5 x1)
Tax rules known for the test environment
Overview step displayed
steps: 1. On Overview, calculate expected item total from visible line items
2. Calculate expected tax per configured rate
3. Verify displayed Item total, Tax and Total match the expected calculation
test_cases.expected_result: Displayed 'Item total', 'Tax' and 'Total' values match the expected calculation and are consistent with line item amounts

test_cases.test_case: Overview displays payment and shipping summary correctly (masked payment, formatted address)
preconditions: User logged in as Customer
Payment method on file (e.g., card ending 1234)
Shipping address present
